bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Minnesota Orchestra.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA ORCHESTRA.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Minnesota Orchestra for arts and cultural heritage programming in musical performance.
